name: Arvind Ltd
about: Arvind Limited (‘the Company’) is one of India’s leading vertically integrated textile company with the presence of almost eight decades in this industry. It is among the largest denim manufacturers in the world. It also manufactures a range of cotton shirting, denim, knits and bottom weights (Khakis) fabrics and Jeans and Shirts Garments. [1]
keyPoints:
Leading Denim Manufacturer[1]
Arvind is a leading manufacturer of denim and woven fabrics, with capacities of 100 million meters per annum (MMPA) and 150 MMPA, respectively, as of March 31, 2023. The company also produces cotton shirting, knits, Khakis, and technical textiles.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 34.0%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 2.48% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 10.1% over last 3 years.
